region_scene_page.standard: Surf music turns place into sound: ocean motion, hot rods, Southern California youth imagery, and electric-guitar technology. The record often feels horizontal and kinetic, like motion across a surface: rolling drums, wet guitar, bright harmonies, and a scene you can picture immediately.
